units.rawText: Huh? Erika, did you just say... you wouldn't...

spans.text: Huh? Erika, did you just say... you wouldn't...

units.rawText: Yes, I won't allow you to stay here. This is a very dangerous place, even more dangerous than a prison cell. The number of Entropics around us are increasing, making it harder and harder to take care of them. There's also the fact that this place looks like it's about to collapse at any moment.

units.rawText: To cleanse all of them of sin will require a great deal of effort. With so many casualties in tow, our lack of manpower and weapons means the chances of success is close to nil.
units.displayText: To cleanse all of them of sin will require a great deal of effort. With so many casualties in tow, our lack of manpower and weapons means the chances of success is close to nil.

spans.text: To cleanse all of them of sin will require a great deal of effort. With so many casualties in tow, our lack of manpower and weapons means the chances of success is close to nil.

units.rawText: Yeah, just setting up that trap took all the operands in our medical equipment and supply lockers. If we run into danger again, we'll be powerless to resist.
units.displayText: Yeah, just setting up that trap took all the operands in our medical equipment and supply lockers. If we run into danger again, we'll be powerless to resist.

spans.text: Yeah, just setting up that trap took all the operands in our medical equipment and supply lockers. If we run into danger again, we'll be powerless to resist.

units.rawText: But you're not the same. You can still go with her. I know there's a folding motorcycle parked near the Medical Department. If you use it, the two of you will be able to escape easily.
units.displayText: But you're not the same. You can still go with her. I know there's a folding motorcycle parked near the Medical Department. If you use it, the two of you will be able to escape easily.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: You once said that safety was important and that I should cherish myself. But when you said that, did you ever consider that your own safety was also very important?
units.displayText: You once said that safety was important and that I should cherish myself. But when you said that, did you ever consider that your own safety was also very important?

spans.text: You once said that safety was important and that I should cherish myself. But when you said that, did you ever consider that your own safety was also very important?

units.rawText: But I don't want to always be the one protected by you, Erika. When you got hurt protecting me from that horde of monsters, I was thinking about what I could do for you and everyone else!
units.displayText: But I don't want to always be the one protected by you, Erika. When you got hurt protecting me from that horde of monsters, I was thinking about what I could do for you and everyone else!

spans.text: But I don't want to always be the one protected by you, Erika. When you got hurt protecting me from that horde of monsters, I was thinking about what I could do for you and everyone else!

units.rawText: Here, take a look! I got hurt when I went to pull that lever just now. I'm like you, I can protect others, I don't have to hide behind you and be protected all the time!
units.displayText: Here, take a look! I got hurt when I went to pull that lever just now. I'm like you, I can protect others, I don't have to hide behind you and be protected all the time!

spans.text: Here, take a look! I got hurt when I went to pull that lever just now. I'm like you, I can protect others, I don't have to hide behind you and be protected all the time!

units.rawText: And there's this! The scriptures you gave me! I listened to everything you said and what it said!
units.displayText: And there's this! The scriptures you gave me! I listened to everything you said and what it said!

spans.text: And there's this! The scriptures you gave me! I listened to everything you said and what it said!

units.rawText: I want to become a person who can protect everyone like you, Erika!
units.displayText: I want to become a person who can protect everyone like you, Erika!

spans.text: I want to become a person who can protect everyone like you, Erika!

units.rawText: Dushevnaya's eyes burn with an inner light that seems to rend the darkness.
units.displayText: Dushevnaya's eyes burn with an inner light that seems to rend the darkness.

spans.text: Dushevnaya's eyes burn with an inner light that seems to rend the darkness.

units.rawText: <size=28>Heh... Perhaps... It might actually end up different this time.</size>
units.displayText: Heh... Perhaps... It might actually end up different this time.

spans.text: Heh... Perhaps... It might actually end up different this time.

units.rawText: And I can heal myself and others, there are medical devices here too, so you don't need to worry...
units.displayText: And I can heal myself and others, there are medical devices here too, so you don't need to worry...

spans.text: And I can heal myself and others, there are medical devices here too, so you don't need to worry...

units.rawText: ...Honestly...
units.displayText: ...Honestly...

spans.text: ...Honestly...

units.rawText: Erika steps forward to pat Dushevnaya's head and cuts off her mumbling.
units.displayText: Erika steps forward to pat Dushevnaya's head and cuts off her mumbling.

spans.text: Erika steps forward to pat Dushevnaya's head and cuts off her mumbling.

units.rawText: Well, since you've made up your mind, I ought to respect your wishes, just like the Professor does for the Dolls in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Well, since you've made up your mind, I ought to respect your wishes, just like the Professor does for the Dolls in the Oasis.

spans.text: Well, since you've made up your mind, I ought to respect your wishes, just like the Professor does for the Dolls in the Oasis.

units.rawText: Huh? R-Really?
units.displayText: Huh? R-Really?

spans.text: Huh? R-Really?

units.rawText: Yes, but you need to protect yourself and keep yourself safe too.
units.displayText: Yes, but you need to protect yourself and keep yourself safe too.

spans.text: Yes, but you need to protect yourself and keep yourself safe too.

units.rawText: Yup yup, I will!
units.displayText: Yup yup, I will!

spans.text: Yup yup, I will!

units.rawText: This is great! Erika said yes! Hehehe, I told you it'd be fine.
units.displayText: This is great! Erika said yes! Hehehe, I told you it'd be fine.

spans.text: This is great! Erika said yes! Hehehe, I told you it'd be fine.

units.rawText: If you stay here, remember to be very careful. Make sure you put up as many roadblocks and fortifications as you can. At the very least, it'll slow them down and give you more time.
units.displayText: If you stay here, remember to be very careful. Make sure you put up as many roadblocks and fortifications as you can. At the very least, it'll slow them down and give you more time.

units.rawText: Alright, I got it! Take care of yourself too, Erika!

spans.text: Alright, I got it! Take care of yourself too, Erika!

units.rawText: Oh yes, I'd like to check your wounds before you head down to the warehouse. Fortunately, we still have some bandages in the treatment room.

units.rawText: Bandaging complete! Why don't you try moving around to see if you're uncomfortable anywhere?

spans.text: Bandaging complete! Why don't you try moving around to see if you're uncomfortable anywhere?

units.rawText: Well, I'm not too used to it, but it feels surprisingly good. Alright, I'm ready to cleanse the enemy of their sins.
units.displayText: Well, I'm not too used to it, but it feels surprisingly good. Alright, I'm ready to cleanse the enemy of their sins.

spans.text: Well, I'm not too used to it, but it feels surprisingly good. Alright, I'm ready to cleanse the enemy of their sins.

units.rawText: Hehehe, it turned out well, right?
units.displayText: Hehehe, it turned out well, right?

spans.text: Hehehe, it turned out well, right?

units.rawText: Indeed. Now the only thing I need now are my guns.
units.displayText: Indeed. Now the only thing I need now are my guns.

spans.text: Indeed. Now the only thing I need now are my guns.

units.rawText: It's okay, you'll get them soon enough, Erika.
units.displayText: It's okay, you'll get them soon enough, Erika.

spans.text: It's okay, you'll get them soon enough, Erika.

units.rawText: This is the door leading outside. The warehouse with your guns isn't far away. I've already marked the route and location. Oh yeah, I also marked the bike that they were talking about just now.
units.displayText: This is the door leading outside. The warehouse with your guns isn't far away. I've already marked the route and location. Oh yeah, I also marked the bike that they were talking about just now.

units.rawText: Yes, I remember them. Just wait for me to come back after getting rid of those Entropics.
units.displayText: Yes, I remember them. Just wait for me to come back after getting rid of those Entropics.

spans.text: Yes, I remember them. Just wait for me to come back after getting rid of those Entropics.

units.rawText: Heh, it's all thanks to everyone lending me all those supplies and medical equipment!
units.displayText: Heh, it's all thanks to everyone lending me all those supplies and medical equipment!

spans.text: Heh, it's all thanks to everyone lending me all those supplies and medical equipment!

units.rawText: Things always turn out well for people who protect others. How did that verse go... "The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord; he is their stronghold in time of trouble."

units.displayText: Erika lightly caresses the freshly-tied bandages, a faint smile spreading across her face.

spans.text: Erika lightly caresses the freshly-tied bandages, a faint smile spreading across her face.

units.rawText: Then I'll entrust you with the duty of protecting this place, while I ensure those sinners out there are duly penitent.
units.displayText: Then I'll entrust you with the duty of protecting this place, while I ensure those sinners out there are duly penitent.

spans.text: Then I'll entrust you with the duty of protecting this place, while I ensure those sinners out there are duly penitent.

units.rawText: After getting my weapons back, I'll think of a way to draw off the wicked around you. May the Lord protect you.
